verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs directly describe this story. Cloud agents run in isolated VMs with full dev environments where they build, test, start dev servers, open the app in a browser, and click through UI flows to verify changes. They then attach screenshots, videos, and log artifacts to the PR so you can review without checking out the branch. Artifacts are also listable and downloadable via the Cloud Agents API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that end-to-end build/test/demo runs work as claimed.
